shots.p: close-up of a woolen cloak lying folded beside a prayer mat in a dark room, moonlight through a small window, a call to rise for night prayer
wide shot of a quiet desert town asleep under a deep blue night sky, one window glowing with lamp light, stillness of the night
time-lapse wide shot of the moon moving across the night sky above a sleeping village, half of the night passing
close-up of an oil lamp beside a prayer mat at night, flame steady, conveying slow measured recitation in calm silence
low angle view of massive mountains under a heavy star-filled night sky, conveying a weighty solemn message
medium shot from behind of an elderly man standing in night prayer in a dim mosque at the deep hour of night, total silence, heart focused
wide shot of a busy daytime market with merchants and travelers moving everywhere under harsh noon sun, long busy day
close-up on the upturned hands of a man in quiet supplication at night, fully devoted, soft candlelight
wide shot of the sun rising in the east and, in a second view, setting in the west over a vast plain, sign of the sole Lord of both
medium shot of a dignified man in a white robe walking calmly away from a group of jeering men in a street, no anger, graceful patience
wide shot of wealthy men lounging on cushions in a luxurious tent with feasts and silks, unaware, the light slowly fading
wide shot of heavy iron shackles lying on scorched rocks before a distant blazing fire in a dark valley, symbolic and non-graphic
close-up of thorny bitter desert plants and a dry cup on parched ground under a burning red sky, sense of choking hardship
wide shot of the earth shaking violently, mountains collapsing into flowing heaps of loose sand pouring down
wide shot of an ancient Egyptian royal palace with towering columns at sunset, proud and imposing, a lone staff resting at the gate
wide shot of the Red Sea waves crashing over an abandoned chariot wheel and a fallen royal standard on the shore, stormy sky
close-up on the face of a young boy whose hair has turned white with fear, wide eyes, grey stormy light, non-graphic
low angle view of a cracked splitting sky with immense fissures of light breaking across dark clouds
wide shot of a clear path climbing a hill toward a bright sunrise, an open invitation to walk it
wide shot of a few believers praying at night in a small mosque while the moon moves
medium shot of a sick man resting in bed reciting a little, a traveler merchant on a camel road, and a guard standing watch at dawn
medium shot of a man handing charity to a poor family, then kneeling in prayer seeking forgiveness, soft morning light
